title_en: One advantage is that it’s fast.
goal_ko: 장점과 단점을 말하고 전체 생각으로 정리하기

expressions.pattern: ^(?:one|the biggest|the main|another) (?:advantage|benefit|good point|upside)(?: of (?<y>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){0,4}?))? is(?: that)? (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: One advantage of online shopping is that it’s fast.
another benefit is you can compare prices
partial: the good thing is it’s fast

help.blank: On the other ___, you can’t try things on.

expressions.pattern: ^(?:on the other hand|however|but on the other hand) (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: On the other hand, you can’t try clothes on.
however it takes a long time

expressions.pattern: ^(?:overall|all in all|on the whole|in general)(?: i think| i feel| i believe)? (?<x>[a-z]+(?: [a-z]+){1,14})$

ok: Overall, I think it’s worth it.
all in all it’s a good idea

scene.en: Sola, do you shop online a lot?
All the time. One advantage is that it’s really fast.
On the other hand, you can’t try clothes on.
That’s a problem. So what do you think?
Overall, I think it’s worth it for small things.
